description: Vue can be adopted gradually, from a single widget to a full application.
Single File Component: a `.vue` file with `<script>`, `<template>` and `<style>` blocks compiled by a build tool.
The standard dev server and bundler for Vue, with fast startup and hot module replacement.
Function-based API (`ref`, `computed`, `watch`) used inside `setup()` or `<script setup>`.
Vue 3.6 opt-in compilation mode that skips the virtual DOM for faster updates and smaller output.
